Design finding 1 (Promises widening) RESOLVED: ForecastingsLegalCallers back to ApplicationCoreRules.TheApi|RefinementPattern; front-door target now ModuleRules.WithoutTheEvents(ForecastingApplication, "Forecasting"). ForecastingApplication = ^...Forecasting\.(Application|Contracts)(\.|$) so Contracts events were the true target of the front door; exempting them by full name is the narrow fix.

Mechanism check (ModuleRules.IsATypeIn): prefix path taken only when pattern starts with ^(?!(?:. Grep of Architecture: exactly one prefixed pattern (ForecastingModuleBoundaries:200, via WithoutTheEvents); no other rule changed. Non-prefixed patterns keep the original ResidesInNamespaceMatching path. Prefixed match is ns + '.' + outermost type name; every module pattern ends in (\.|$), so appending the type name keeps the namespace match. Exemption is by full-name equality, so a same-named type in another namespace is not exempt. Latent caveat only: a future prefixed pattern ending in an exact namespace $ would stop matching types in that namespace.
